messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] besag model error message
parts: On Fri, 2014-11-07 at 04:47 -0800, liyuji...@gmail.com wrote:

> The graph for the model besag has 1140 connected components!!! Model
> is revised accordingly.

I think this is the source for the problem. with so many connected
components, m say, inla will create internally a dense `m x n' matrix,
where 'n' is the size of the graph. quite likely, this is why it crash
as this matrix is simply to much.

also, 1140 connected components, then there is an issue if this model is
what you want (I do not think so...), or if this
adjust.for.con.comp=TRUE is what you want.

Best
H
